root_cause.text: In `damon_sysfs_context_add_dirs()`, when context setup fails after the `attrs/` directory has been created (e.g., due to failure in setting up targets or schemes), the error-handling path omits removal of the subdirectories under `attrs/`, leading to leaked sysfs directories and memory.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the failure label from `put_attrs_out` to `rmdir_put_attrs_out` and adds `damon_sysfs_attrs_rm_dirs(context->attrs)` before `kobject_put(&context->attrs->kobj)`. The commit message explicitly states: "When a context DAMON sysfs directory setup is failed after setup of attrs/ directory, subdirectories of attrs/ directory are not cleaned up."
